resources.string: Pixel-art fighting game — multiple characters, weapons, and duels!

Pixel Duel is a classic pixel-art 2D fighting game.
[Features] ✦ 4 unique fighters: Warrior, Ninja, Monk, Knight ✦ 6 weapons: Sword, Dual Daggers, Magic Staff, Iron Club, Spear, Battle Axe ✦ Combo system + Special moves ✦ Single Player VS AI (4 difficulty levels) ✦ Local 2-Player battle ✦ Best-of-3 rounds ✦ No internet required — fully offline
[Controls] On-screen virtual buttons for move, jump, attack, block, and special.
[Content Rating] Contains cartoon-style fighting (no blood or gore). Suitable for ages 10 and up.
